page.layout: One block, centred on the page: a printer's imprint of three lines, below a horizontal rule. A library stamp sits above the rule and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The horizontal rule above the imprint is an ornament, not text. The oval library stamp above it is excluded. The imprint is set in italic with the last line in capitals; the capital V is read as U per the convention for the vowel, giving LUGDUNI.
